en.shortDescription: Open-source LLM observability and analytics platform
en.longDescription:
Helicone provides LLM tracing, analytics, and monitoring for production AI applications.

All-in-one image includes dashboard (3000), Jawn API (8585), and MinIO (9080). Auth secret uses SERVICE_PASSWORD_64_HELICONE.
